in_marathi.name: Balasaheb
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Strength
in_marathi.long_meaning: Balasaheb हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Balasaheb is a name derived from the Marathi language. It is a combination of two words: 'Bala', which means 'strength', and 'Sahib', which means 'master' or 'lord'. This name is commonly used for boys in the Indian subcontinent, especially in Maharashtra. It is believed that a Balasaheb is a powerful and strong individual, who is capable of leading and ruling.
